title: Grateful Dead Live at Warfield Theater on 1982-02-17
source: Recorded, Transferred and Mastered by N. Hoey; 2 Nakamichi CM 300 > Sony TC D-5m (Dolby B)(Maxell UDXL-IIS 90) (Lower Loge Section 3 Row AA Seats 3-7) Nakamichi Dragon (Dolby B decoded) > TC Electronics Konnekt8 (A/D conversion)(transferred @ 88.2/24-resampled to 44.1k/dithered to 16 bit) > Apple OS X 10.5.8 (Peak 6 editing-resampling-dithering) > Xact

ai_review.summary: High‑energy, well‑played show captured in a good‑quality source
ai_review.review: Both reviewers describe the performance as solid and fun, noting that the band stays loose and on throughout the set, with particular praise for how well it is played up to midway through the second set. The recording itself receives commendation for being done “very well,” though no technical details are offered.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews are strongly positive (4‑5 stars) and highlight a good performance and satisfactory recording, leading to an overall high rating despite limited detail.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers thank the creator for doing a good job, indicating the audio is clear enough to enjoy, but no specific source (soundboard/audience) or technical issues are mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No detailed comments on set structure; reviewers note the performance stays strong through at least half of the second set.
